market_question: Will Keisha Lance Bottoms win the 2026 Georgia Governor Democratic primary election?
reasoning: Keisha Lance Bottoms has filed paperwork for governor, but the primary is over a year away and other strong candidates, including Stacey Abrams, could enter. A 93.5% implied probability dramatically overstates her chance of winning a contested primary. I estimate a ~60% probability, leaving a large edge favoring No.
evidence_points: Bottoms filed to run in February 2025, becoming an official candidate.
Stacey Abrams, who nearly won in 2018 and 2022, has not ruled out a 2026 run and would be a formidable challenger.
The field remains unsettled with no polling, making a 93.5% probability unrealistically high.
sources_consulted: AP News: 'Keisha Lance Bottoms files paperwork to run for Georgia governor' (Feb 6, 2025)
